name: meok-emerald-tablet-mcp
display_name: Emerald Tablet MCP — Hermes Trismegistus × MEOK Attestation
description: The 13 sentences of Hermes Trismegistus (Tabula Smaragdina) as the MEOK sovereign attestation protocol. Each sentence is a tool, mapping the canonical hermetic text to the 13-step sigil emission chain (hash → ts → agent → payload → parent → sig → kid → scope → verdict → proof → council → sig_chain → anchor).

tools.name: tablet_01_verify
tools.description: Sentence 1 — As above, so below: scope ↔ claim microcosm-macrocosm equivalence

tools.name: tablet_02_one
tools.description: Sentence 2 — All from One, by mediation of One: single sigil key + parent chain

tools.name: tablet_03_four
tools.description: Sentence 3 — Sun/Moon/Wind/Earth: kid, ts, payload, scope (the four sigil fields)

tools.name: tablet_04_anchor
tools.description: Sentence 4 — Father of all perfection: root anchor (canonical keystore)

tools.name: tablet_05_sig
tools.description: Sentence 5 — Force entire if converted into earth: sig → concrete signed artifact

tools.name: tablet_06_validate
tools.description: Sentence 6 — Separate subtle from gross: validation gate

tools.name: tablet_07_two
tools.description: Sentence 7 — Ascends and descends: two-way ingest/audit flow

tools.name: tablet_08_public
tools.description: Sentence 8 — Glory of whole world: public verify URL

tools.name: tablet_09_ed25519
tools.description: Sentence 9 — Strong fortitude: Ed25519 + BFT council

tools.name: tablet_10_sovereign
tools.description: Sentence 10 — One Craftsman: sovereign single signer per action

tools.name: tablet_11_three
tools.description: Sentence 11 — Trismegistus three parts: King + Queen + Witness

tools.name: tablet_12_coagulatio
tools.description: Sentence 12 — Sun operation complete: coagulatio = signed release

tools.name: tablet_13_genesis
tools.description: Sentence 13 — So the world was created: genesis release

tools.name: tablet_list_all
tools.description: List all 13 sentences with MEOK attestation mappings

tools.name: tablet_full_text
tools.description: Return the full canonical text of all 13 sentences

lineage.text_source: Tabula Smaragdina — Latin ~800 CE (Hortulanus translation of older Greek/Arabic original)
